name: Make Your Own Magic: Hats & Broom
label: Hands-on workshop
address: 522 Second Street SE Suite D, Charlottesville, VA, 22902
description:
What does your magic look like? In this hands-on workshop, you'll start with two unexpected canvases- a black woven witch hat and a 4-inch cinnamon broom. With your imagination to guide you, you'll turn them into pieces that reflect your own style, and personality.
 You'll have plenty of time to personalize your pieces using a variety of materials, and embellishments. And because the best accessories tell a story, you're welcome to bring along your own small treasures to work into your designs.
 Maybe your inner witch is spooky. Maybe she's whimsical. Maybe she's glamorous, earthy, or a little bit of everything. There's no wrong way to make your magic; so come ready to play, create, and see where your imagination takes you!
